summary: argo-cd D66 records the Destroy Stage pipeline: guard, destroy entry point, empty configuration, forgotten namespaced objects, removals, re-runs, webhook and the dedicated identity. It supersedes D28 and amends D1, D27, D31, D33, D39 and D41, carrying Ruling Q1's narrow overrule (AnsibleSpecs ffdaeeb). Close-out gained B1 (the Jenkins controller's cluster-wide core ClusterRole) and D1 (the identity's exclusivity is convention-only).
